Composition & Indication

Metoprolol Tartrate 100mg — 30 Tablets contains Metoprolol Tartrate 100 mg as the active ingredient. This presentation ships as a sealed pack of 30 Tablets at the official 100mg strength. The standard indication is the management of high blood pressure and cardiac arrhythmias, per Mexican pharmacopeia labeling.

Typical Use

Metoprolol Tartrate 100mg is typically taken under medical supervision. Dose and duration should follow your physician’s prescription. Do not self-medicate. Possible side effects include common reactions described in the patient leaflet; consult your healthcare provider if any adverse symptom appears or persists.
